problems.title: Technology should remove friction, not create more of it.
problems.description: We start with the business or operational problem, not a list of tools. These are common signs that a digital solution could help.

items.contacts: Your website gets traffic but does not generate inquiries.
items.presence: Your digital presence does not reflect the quality of your business.
items.manual: Manual processes consume valuable time every day.
items.scattered: Information is scattered across WhatsApp and spreadsheets.
items.repetitive: Your team repeats tasks that could be simplified.
items.complex: Current systems are more complicated than they need to be.
items.rigid: Your tools force the business to change how it operates.

services.title: Clear solutions for better operations and steady growth.
services.description: Every project connects a specific need with a solution the team can use and maintain.

presence.title: Digital presence
presence.problem: The business does not clearly communicate its value or relies on channels it does not control.
presence.outcome: A professional presence that explains, builds confidence, and makes it easy to get in touch.
presence.examples: Company websites, landing pages, and restaurant websites.

systems.title: Business systems
systems.problem: Important information and tasks are spread across files, chats, and manual processes.
systems.outcome: A more organized operation with the right information in one place.
systems.examples: Internal dashboards, portals, inventory, and operational tools.

automation.title: Automation
automation.problem: The team spends time on repetitive tasks, follow-ups, and moving information between tools.
automation.outcome: Faster workflows that reduce manual work while keeping people in control.
automation.examples: Notifications, lead follow-up, and process integrations.

featured.title: Projects that turn a real need into a useful tool.
featured.description: Products and solutions designed around real operations, without claiming results that have not been measured.

metadata.title: Privacy policy | Fuentivo
metadata.description: How Fuentivo collects, uses, and protects information submitted through its contact form.

PrivacyPage.title: Privacy policy
PrivacyPage.intro: This policy describes how information you share with Fuentivo through this website is actually handled.

collected.title: Information we collect
collected.body: The form asks for your name, business or company, email address or WhatsApp number, type of solution, and message. It also processes technical anti-spam fields, including a honeypot and the time elapsed before submission.

purpose.title: How it is used
purpose.body: We use this information to respond to your inquiry, understand the problem, evaluate whether Fuentivo can help, and follow up on the conversation you requested. It is not used to sell contact lists or send unsolicited advertising campaigns.

delivery.title: Delivery and storage
delivery.body: The website validates the information on the server and sends it through Resend to Fuentivo's inbox. The application does not store messages in its own database, but email may remain in Resend's and Google's systems until deleted under their processes and the management of the inbox. An internal retention period has not yet been established.

analytics.title: Analytics and cookies
analytics.body: The website currently uses no analytics tools or analytics or advertising cookies. The hosting provider may generate technical logs required for security, stability, and diagnostics. This policy will be updated before analytics or similar technologies are introduced.

providers.title: Service providers
providers.body: Vercel hosts and runs the website; Resend processes form delivery; and Google receives the message in Fuentivo's inbox. Each provider processes technical or message data only for the function needed to deliver its service.

requests.title: Requests about your information
requests.body: To access, correct, or request deletion of a message, email fuentivo@gmail.com. Fuentivo will respond based on the information available and any applicable obligations.

pending.title: Pre-production note
pending.body: The legal identity responsible for data handling and the internal retention period must be confirmed before public launch. This policy is not a claim of absolute legal compliance.
